name: proj-kanban-board
description: Designs a Kanban board with columns that match the real workflow, WIP limits per column and blocked markers, then computes the four flow measures and lists the oldest items to swarm. Use for "run proj-kanban-board", "kanban board", "set WIP limits", "too much work in progress", "nothing gets finished", "cycle time and throughput", "work item age", "what should we swarm", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
